prereg.slack_sign: slack is defined per pair so that the physical inequality holds iff slack >= 0 (ms)

tol_ms_event_clock.reason: ISO timestamps at 1 ms resolution: a difference of two stamps can be off by <1 ms, an integer-ms timer by <1 ms more

tol_ms_row_insert_clock.reason: AI Village created_at has us resolution; only the integer-ms timer rounds

gross_ms.reason: a violation larger than 1 s cannot be rounding at any resolution used here except whole-second fields, which get their own rule

elapsed_seconds_rule.any_rounding: lag_ms >= 1000*(elapsedTimeSeconds - 1) - tol (holds for floor, round or ceil)
elapsed_seconds_rule.floor: lag_ms >= 1000*elapsedTimeSeconds - tol (holds only if the timer is floored)
elapsed_seconds_rule.reason: elapsedTimeSeconds is an integer; its rounding rule is not documented

timeout_grace_ms.reason: a harness timer may overrun its own timeout by kill/teardown latency; 1 s is generous for that and smaller than any timeout in the data

gap_over_timeout_report_ms.reason: call->result gaps include permission/approval waits, so gap > timeout is descriptive, not a violation; >5 s reported

http_date_resolution_ms.reason: HTTP Date header is floored to the second

epoch_seconds_resolution_ms.reason: Codex started_at/completed_at are integer epoch seconds

apply_patch_duration_seconds_tol_ms.reason: metadata.duration_seconds is printed at 0.1 s: half a step (50 ms) + event-clock tol

turn_duration.value: no direction assumed; tested span >= durationMs - tol AND |span - durationMs| <= 1000 ms, for two turn-start definitions (last human prompt before the turn_duration event; first human prompt after the previous turn_duration)
turn_duration.reason: the timer's start point is undocumented

stop_hooks.value: slack_max = (summary.ts - first hook_progress(Stop, same toolUseID).ts) - max(hookInfos.durationMs) must be >= -tol; slack_sum (with sum) reported as a parallel-vs-serial probe, not a violation
stop_hooks.reason: hooks of one event cannot run longer than the wall time between their start and the summary

api_error_retry.value: child entry (raw parentUuid == this api_error uuid): child.ts - api_error.ts >= retryInMs - tol
api_error_retry.reason: the harness sleeps retryInMs before retrying; the child is written after the retry

uuid7.value: a UUID whose version nibble is 7 carries unix ms in its first 48 bits; residual = event ts - uuid ms

opencode_ids.value: OpenCode ascending ids: hex12 after the prefix = (ms*0x1000 + counter) mod 2^48, so ms mod 2^36 = hex12 // 0x1000; descending ids (ses_) are the bitwise NOT. Residual = reference ms - decoded ms, unwrapped to the nearest multiple of 2^36
opencode_ids.reason: hypothesis from the id layout; tested, not assumed (a null is reported if it fails)

max_examples.reason: violator examples listed per pair, public corpora only

prereg.corpora_split: Phase B caches only (2000 swechat, 186 cc_local, 189 aiv_cc, 2000 aiv_cu sessions); raw reads restricted to B sessions

post_hoc.time_conversion_fix: run 0 divided pandas datetime int64 by 1e6 assuming ns, but pandas 3 infers us/ms units from the strings; all gaps were off by 1000x. Fixed (unit-agnostic Timedelta division) before any number was interpreted; no reported number comes from run 0.

post_hoc.cc_bash_progress.parent_split: run 1 pooled progress whose parent is a Task/Agent call (a subagent's Bash reporting under the parent id) with direct Bash progress; split afterwards. any_rounding/floor violations were 0 in both versions; tick statistics are now direct-Bash only. tick_gaps_over_1500ms and calls_over_timeout were added after the single elapsed>timeout case was inspected.
post_hoc.cc_turn_duration.POSTHOC_resid_by_calls_: added after run 1 showed the residual is not near 0 (|res|<=1 s ~22%)
post_hoc.cc_subagent_containment.POSTHOC_total_vs: added after run 1 (gap - totalDurationMs looked equal to first-nested - call; cc_local containment failed 63/63)
post_hoc.cc_raw.api_error_retry.POSTHOC_child_is_: added after inspecting the 5 violators (user interrupts, another concurrent retry loop)
post_hoc.cc_raw.api_error_retry.POSTHOC_retryInMs: band 500*2^(a-1)*[1,1.25] capped at 32000 read off retryInMs_by_attempt in run 1, then counted; it is a description, not a test
post_hoc.cc_raw.hook_attachments.POSTHOC_*_vs_cal: run 1 found 0 attachment<->hook_progress joins (versions writing hook attachments write no hook_progress); the tool call is used as the start anchor
post_hoc.cc_raw.tool_hook_progress_vs_call_result: added with the attachment change (ordering of hook start vs call/result)
post_hoc.cc_identical_timestamps: whole section added after the gap-0 Glob turned out to sit in a block of identically stamped entries (v1.0.112) and the negative Glob in a transient backward reading
post_hoc.codex.POSTHOC_running_output_gap_ge_min_: run 1: 9/1682 violations, every violator's header says 'Wall time: 30.0x seconds' with yield_time_ms 120000/1200000; effective cap 30 s
post_hoc.codex.exited_before_yield_duration_le_yi: run 1 (all results with a yield, incl. write_stdin results carrying a deferred process duration): 452/2524 violations; restricted to exec_command results with their own end: 0/1791. post_hoc.codex.POSTHOC_end_ts_minus_started_at_vs: added after run 1: 16/77 end.ts - task_started.ts < duration_ms and 18/89 task_started events logged >1 s after started_at

post_hoc.opencode.part_id_clock role split: run 1 keyed parts by type only; 'text' mixed user and assistant parts (267/1079 violations, all user); now keyed type|role
post_hoc.opencode.session_updated_ge_last_message: added after run 1 (208/214 violations) to locate what updated tracks

end_vs_file_last_event.inequality: startTime + totalDuration >= last event ts of the file

exited_before_yield_duration_le_yield.inequality: exec_command output not 'running' (own end) => duration <= yield_time_ms + grace

reasoning|assistant.inequality: reasoning|assistant part time.start >= part id ms

text|assistant.inequality: text|assistant part time.start >= part id ms

text|user.inequality: text|user part time.start >= part id ms

tool.inequality: tool part time.start >= part id ms

gap_ge_server_dur.inequality: created_at - previous row created_at >= server_timing dur

http_date_ceiling_minus_prev_ge_dur.inequality: (http_date + 1 s) - previous row created_at >= server_timing dur

aiv_cc_reused_from_aiv_accounting.source: analysis/out/phase_c/aiv_accounting.json (all 314 runs, raw stream; not the B split)

duration_ms_ge_tool_gap_sum.definition: duration_ms >= sum of call->result created_at gaps

duration_api_ms_ge_createdat_api_estimat.definition: duration_api_ms >= sum over responses of (last row created_at - created_at of the row before the response's first row)
